newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks end down on banks, finance sales.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks end down on banks, finance sales.

text.p: Thai stocks closed lower on Monday as interest rate, economic and quarterly results concerns sparked sales of finance and bank stocks, traders said.
The composite SET index fell 3.66 points to 705.43. The SET-50 index dropped 0.41 points to 52.18. The closure of many international markets saw trade dwindle to 1.377 billion baht.

"Local investors were reluctant to enter the market as they preferred foreigners to lead. Investors are awaiting for the first quarter corporate results which many had expected to be poor," said Bumnan Liumsuwan of Asia Credit.
